content.text: In Nigeria, digital creators face a stark reality: platforms like Teachable and Stripe are not options. Your ability to sell courses or digital products hinges on infrastructure you control. This isn't about finding a workaround—it's about building a system where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-step-step-deployment-5|payment]] processing, product delivery, and data ownership are decoupled from platforms that exclude you. Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides this. It's not a patch; it's a permanent base layer. Here, we compare your real choices for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-without-stripe-which-architecture-actually-15|COREMERCH guide to selling]] without Stripe or Teachable. We'll analyze what each option delivers, how they handle restricted regions, their true costs, and which [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-presets-without-stripe-stripe-6|The Real]] aligns with your goals. The choice isn't between convenience and control—it's between renting a system that can abandon you and owning one that cannot.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Conventional platforms like Teachable and Stripe offer an illusion of simplicity. They handle hosting, payments, and delivery—until they don’t. In restricted countries like Nigeria, these platforms are inaccessible, leaving creators stranded. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, by contrast, is a self-owned stack. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys a combination of GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. You get hosting, backend logic, order storage, and crypto payment processing—all without relying on a single third-party platform. The tradeoff is clear: conventional platforms offer ease until they fail you; sovereign infrastructure offers permanence at the cost of initial setup. If you’re building a business that cannot afford to be shut down by a platform’s policy change, the choice is structural, not tactical.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Teachable and Stripe exclude countries based on financial regulations, political risks, or market size. This isn’t a bug—it’s their business model. They prioritize regions with stable currencies and low fraud rates, leaving creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe without access. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses this entirely. By using crypto payments via NOWPayments, you accept 300+ cryptocurrencies from anyone, anywhere. There’s no KYC, no buyer account required, and no geographic restrictions. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this in 48 hours, configured for your products. It’s not a workaround; it’s a new base layer. While conventional platforms gatekeep access, sovereign infrastructure ensures your business operates on your terms, regardless of where you’re located or what currency you prefer.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, but that’s irrelevant if you can’t use it. In Nigeria, local payment gateways often charge 5-7% plus additional fees for currency conversion. NOWPayments, integrated into the Edge Commerce Stack, charges a flat 0.5% for crypto transactions. Payments confirm on-chain within minutes, and the webhook triggers instant product delivery. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The real cost comparison isn’t just fees—it’s availability. Conventional platforms may offer lower fees in supported regions, but they’re useless where they’re blocked. Sovereign infrastructure ensures you can collect payment from anyone, anywhere, with minimal fees and no platform lock-in. The tradeoff is clear: higher initial setup cost for lifetime ownership and global reach.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures your business cannot be shut down by a platform’s policy change.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Teachable and Stripe own your data, your customer relationships, and your ability to operate. If they shut you down, you lose everything. Sovereign commerce infrastructure inverts this. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you own the hosting, the backend logic, the order database, and the delivery mechanism. Payments are verified on-chain, and product delivery is automated via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access—you control everything. This isn’t just about avoiding platform fees; it’s about building a business that cannot be taken from you. Automation ensures orders are processed 24/7, and delivery is instant. The tradeoff is upfront complexity for permanent autonomy. If you’re building a business that must outlast platform policies, this is the only architecture that guarantees it.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a region where Stripe and Teachable are unavailable, your choice is already made—you need sovereign commerce infrastructure. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for creators who cannot afford to be locked out of their own business. It’s ideal for selling courses, ebooks, templates, or software in regions where conventional platforms fail. If you’re in a supported Stripe region, the decision is harder: do you prioritize temporary convenience or permanent ownership? For creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other restricted countries, the answer is clear. Sovereign infrastructure isn’t just an alternative—it’s the only architecture that ensures your business operates on your terms, without geographic or financial gatekeepers. Choose based on what you cannot afford to lose.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free, scalable deployment. 2. Set up backend logic: Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order processing. 3. Configure order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets for tracking purchases. 4. Prepare file delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure, instant access. 5. Integrate payments: NOWPayments for automatic crypto verification and webhook triggers. 6. Load your products: Upload courses, ebooks, or templates to your delivery system. 7. Test end-to-end: Ensure payment confirmation fires product delivery without fail. 8. Deploy and own: Once live, the stack is yours—no platform access required.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use the Edge Commerce Stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The stack is deployed for you, with 5 products loaded and end-to-end tested. You own and control it after deployment, with no ongoing technical requirements.
What cryptocurrencies can my customers use?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON offer low transaction fees under $0.10.
Do I need to set up a buyer account for my customers?
No. NOWPayments requires no buyer account or KYC. Customers pay directly from their crypto wallet, and the webhook triggers instant delivery.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates as a payment processor—if it fails, you can replace it with another crypto gateway without altering your stack. Your infrastructure remains intact.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is built on scalable tools like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase. The Sovereign Blueprint includes a scaling playbook for high-volume operations.
